Job Title: Full Stack Developer (AI-First)
Department: Engineering
Reports To: Engineering Lead
Location: Remote, CST
Compensation: Competitive salary based on experience

About Us:

We are a fast-growing, high-performance agency operating at the intersection of eCommerce, Amazon, growth, systems, and AI. Our team helps ambitious brands scale, and were increasingly focused on building internal tools, automation layers, intelligence systems, and AI-powered products that drastically improve business operations. We are not interested in using AI in a superficial way—were creating an AI-native agency model where intelligent systems enhance internal workflows, data visibility, decision-making, execution speed, and product capabilities.

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • Youre satisfied with maintaining old workflows or outdated methods.
  • You dont think about the future of AI and emerging tools.
  • You struggle to quickly learn new tools and technologies.
  • You prefer working in slow-moving, non-agile environments.
  • You dont enjoy building scalable, high-performance software.

This Role IS For You If:

  • Youre passionate about AI and building intelligent systems that drive real business impact.
  • Youre a builder who thrives on experimenting with new technologies and pushing boundaries.
  • Youre fluent in both frontend and backend development and excited by full-stack engineering.
  • You think in terms of leverage: automating processes, making workflows smarter, and using AI to increase output and decision-making.
  • You are a self-starter who takes ownership, moves fast, and is excited to work in a fast-paced, high-agency environment.

What Success Looks Like:

In your first 90 days, you will:

  • Build Scalable Systems: Develop modern full-stack applications, covering frontend, backend, databases, and infrastructure.
  • Integrate AI: Use Claude Code and other AI tools to drive faster development and smarter workflows.
  • Prototype New Ideas: Experiment with new products and features, quickly prototyping and refining the best ideas into production systems.
  • Automate Workflows: Develop AI-first workflows and automation tools to eliminate repetitive tasks.
  • Collaborate with Leadership: Work closely with leadership to identify high-leverage areas where AI and software can have the biggest impact.

Your Responsibilities:

1. Full Stack Development

  • Frontend Development: Build modern, scalable front-end applications using frameworks like React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
  • Backend Development: Develop backend systems with Node.js, Python, and scalable system designs.
  • System Design: Design and implement APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure to power applications.

2. AI Integration

  • Claude Code Utilization: Use Claude Code extensively to speed up software development, including building, debugging, refactoring, and exploring architecture.
  • AI-First Tools: Build AI-powered utilities and tools that integrate seamlessly into business processes.

3. Product and System Innovation

  • Automation: Automate internal processes, including data workflows, and build agent-based systems to reduce manual work.
  • AI Copilots: Create AI assistants and intelligent interfaces that help internal and external users improve productivity.
  • Prototyping: Rapidly prototype new product ideas and features, then refine the most promising ones into production-ready systems.

4. Collaboration & Experimentation

  • Leadership Collaboration: Partner with leadership to identify opportunities where AI and software can create leverage and deliver value.
  • Tool and Model Experimentation: Stay on the cutting edge by experimenting with new AI models, tools, and frameworks.

What Were Looking For:

Required Skills & Traits:

  • Strong experience as a Full Stack Developer.
  • Experience with modern frontend tools like React, Next.js, TypeScript, or similar.
  • Strong backend experience using Node.js, Python, APIs, databases, and scalable system design.
  • Proficiency with Claude Code for building, debugging, and optimizing software.
  • A genuine obsession with AI, emerging tools, and the future of software development.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively in a fast-moving team.
  • Ability to move quickly, take ownership, and solve complex problems with minimal direction.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open-source models.
  • Familiarity with building agent frameworks, RAG, vector databases, or tool-calling systems.
  • Experience building internal platforms, analytics systems, or automation tools.
  • Startup or high-performance agency experience.
  • Experience shipping software quickly while maintaining high engineering standards.

Why This Role Is Different:

This is not a maintenance role. Its not for someone comfortable with slow-moving corporate environments or traditional development. This role is for someone who wants to help shape the future of an ambitious, AI-first company and play a key part in developing the products that come out of it. Youll have room to experiment, push ideas forward, and help define how AI truly integrates into a business with real momentum.

Application Process:

  1. Submit Your Application: Send your resume and a brief cover letter detailing your relevant experience.
  2. Assessment: If shortlisted, complete an assessment to showcase your technical skills and ability to think strategically.
  3. Interview: Candidates will go through 1-2 rounds of interviews to evaluate your full-stack development expertise, AI fluency, and problem-solving approach.

Ready to Shape the Future? Apply Now!

We are an equal opportunity employer and celebrate diversity in our workforce.

In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

Job Description:

Parsons is seeking a skilled Integrated Master Scheduler to join our growing team!

In this role you will be joining a small, fast-moving program team supporting a classified space portfolio. You will be responsible for building, maintaining, and analyzing an Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) across multiple projects, ensuring schedule integrity, resource alignment, and program fidelity to key milestones. This role requires a detail-oriented critical thinker and self-starter who can pull in data from various data sets independently and make recommendations enabling program management decisions.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Develop, maintain, and status the program IMS in Microsoft Project, ensuring fully networked logic, dependencies, and alignment with program milestones.

  • Perform critical path analysis, resource loading, and schedule performance tracking.

  • Ensure integration of schedules across IPTs, suppliers, WBS elements, and subcontractors.

  • Apply resource loading to support realistic staffing plans and capacity assessments in coordination with program leads and business management.

  • Prepare and deliver schedule reports, metrics, and forecasts.

  • Support schedule risk assessments and “what-if” analyses to evaluate alternatives, quantify schedule risk, and inform risk mitigation strategies.

  • Maintain configuration control of the baseline schedule, documenting changes, rationales, and impacts.

  • Ensure schedule activities and logic reflect technical baselines, interfaces, and dependencies across space, ground, software, integration, and test activities.

  • Contribute to acquisition and program planning (e.g. IMS deliverables, CDRLs, proposal volumes, Integrated Master Plan, RFP responses, and task order proposals).

  • Contribute to preparation and review of acquisition documents, technical reviews, and schedule-related contract deliverables and proposals.

What Required Skills You'll Bring:

  • Active TS/SCI required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Project Management, or related field, with additional years of experience counting in lieu of a degree.

  • 5+ years of experience in program scheduling in a program office or large system development environment, preferably in space, defense, or aerospace.

  • Demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft Project for building and maintaining fully networked schedules, including dependencies, constraints, and resource assignments.

  • Experience supporting Integrated Master Schedules for complex, multi-discipline programs with multiple IPTs and subcontractors.

  • Understanding of EVM principles.

  • Experience conducting critical path analysis and communicating schedule status, risks, and impacts to program stakeholders.

  • Project management principles

  • Ability to communicate technical and programmatic information clearly across diverse teams

What Desired Skills You'll Bring:

  • Prior experience supporting a space system program in a government or industry program office.

  • Familiarity with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) tools and methods and ability to align schedule activities with system models and architectures.

  • Familiarity with systems engineering (requirements, design, integration, verification, validation) and their translation into schedule logic and milestones.

  • Experience with configuration management processes and tools, including maintaining traceability between the IMS, baselines, and program documentation.

  • Experience writing or contributing to acquisition and program documents (e.g. IMP, RFPs and proposals) for DoD or intelligence community customers.

Security Clearance Requirement:

An active Top Secret SCI security clearance is required for this position.​This position is part of our Federal Solutions team.The Federal Solutions segment delivers resources to our US government customers that ensure the success of missions around the globe. Our intelligent employees drive the state of the art as they provide services and solutions in the areas of defense, security, intelligence, infrastructure, and environmental. We promote a culture of excellence and close-knit teams that take pride in delivering, protecting, and sustaining our nation's most critical assets, from Earth to cyberspace. Throughout the company, our people are anticipating what’s next to deliver the solutions our customers need now.Salary Range: $103,500.00 - $181,100.00We value our employees and want our employees to take care of their overall wellbeing, which is why we offer best-in-class benefits such as medical, dental, vision, paid time off, Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), 401(k), life insurance, flexible work schedules, and holidays to fit your busy lifestyle!This position will be posted for a minimum of 3 days and will continue to be posted for an average of 30 days until a qualified applicant is selected or the position has been cancelled.Parsons is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other protected status.We truly invest and care about our employee’s wellbeing and provide endless growth opportunities as the sky is the limit, so aim for the stars! Imagine next and join the Parsons quest—APPLY TODAY!

  • Thrive in a creative technical role assisting partners building a technical business delivery model.

raw.description:
BP3 is seeking a hands-on Support Engineer with strong experience in Blue Prism to join our support and managed services team. This role focuses on supporting, maintaining, and evolving production Blue Prism environments for enterprise clients, often as part of long-term managed service engagements.

You will work closely with BP3 architects, database teams, and client stakeholders to ensure stable operations, timely issue resolution, and continuous improvement of Blue Prism platforms - including infrastructure components such as SQL Server, monitoring tooling, and environment configuration.

This is not a “ticket factory” role. It requires solid platform and infrastructure expertise, including the ability to troubleshoot across the application, database, and operating system layers, sound technical judgment, strong communication skills, and the ability to build trusted relationships with customers.

Key Responsibilities

Blue Prism Platform Support

  • Provide day-to-day operational support for Blue Prism environments (on-prem)
  • Diagnose and resolve customer-reported issues across:
  • Blue Prism Application Server, Robot runtime, and environment configuration
    • Blue Prism HUB and related components
    • Authentication, user management, and permissions
    • Connectivity, scheduling, and queue management
  • Analyze issues to determine whether they stem from platform configuration, infrastructure, or solution design, and implement or recommend appropriate corrective changes
  • Plan, coordinate, and execute Blue Prism platform upgrades and version transitions, including HUB upgrades

Infrastructure & Database Coordination

  • Coordinate with database teams to plan and execute SQL Server upgrades (e.g., MSSQL 2016 migrations)
  • Support the setup and configuration of Blue Prism reporting databases, including coordination with DB teams on schema, access, and data flow
  • Plan and execute failover server configurations for Blue Prism environments
  • Perform routine system maintenance including health checks, configuration reviews, and environment documentation Monitoring & Observability
  • Maintain and improve existing Dynatrace monitoring for Blue Prism infrastructure
  • Identify gaps in monitoring coverage and implement new monitors proactively
  • Use monitoring data to surface recurring issues and drive operational improvements

Client-Facing Support

  • Act as a trusted technical contact for clients running Blue Prism in production
  • Communicate clearly about issues, root causes, and remediation steps
  • Balance responsiveness with thoughtful, sustainable solutions

Collaboration & Escalation

  • Work with BP3 architects and senior engineers on complex or systemic issues
  • Coordinate with Blue Prism support when defects or product-level issues are identified

Contribute to documentation, runbooks, and operational knowledge transfer

Requirements

Required Experience

  • Hands-on experience supporting Blue Prism in production environments
  • Solid understanding of Blue Prism architecture, including Application Server, HUB, runtime resources, and database dependencies
  • Experience planning and executing Blue Prism upgrades and patching cycles
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server, including basic query writing, connectivity troubleshooting, and coordination with DBA teams
  • Working knowledge of Windows Server administration, including:
    • Log analysis and event viewer
    • Service management and restarts
    • Basic scripting (PowerShell or similar)
    • File system and permission management
  • Experience working in support or managed services environments
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and communicate clearly in both written and verbal form

Preferred Experience

  • Familiarity with Dynatrace or comparable APM/infrastructure monitoring tools
  • Experience configuring or supporting failover and high-availability setups for application environments
  • Enterprise networking fundamentals (DNS, load balancers, SSL/TLS, firewall rules) as they relate to production troubleshooting
  • Prior client-facing consulting or enterprise support experience

Optional / Growth Areas

As part of BP3’s broader intelligent automation practice, this role offers opportunities to expand beyond Blue Prism over time, based on interest and business need. These areas are not required on day one.

  • Exposure to other RPA platforms, including Automation Anywhere
  • Opportunities to work with workflow automation platforms such as IBM BAW or Camunda
  • Experience supporting hybrid automation architectures that combine RPA, workflow, and integration technologies
  • Collaboration with BP3 delivery teams on multi-platform automation solutions

This provides a path for engineers who want to broaden their automation skill set while maintaining a strong foundation in Blue Prism infrastructure.

Benefits

    • Remote work;
    • 26 (22 + 4) annual leave days;
    • Career development plan;
    • Continuous alignment with the established goals;
    • Annual training budget;
    • Opportunity to work in a challenging environment with dynamic teams and innovative projects;
    • Health insurance since the first day of employment (extensive to family members).

Employment Type: Full Time, Permanent

Reports to: Portfolio HR Manager

Location: Remote, USA

The Company

Lumine Group is publicly traded on the TSX Venture Exchange (TSXV:LMN). Lumine Group acquires, strengthens, and grows communications & media software businesses. Lumine Group’s focus is always long-term – we buy and hold forever, and we believe in the long-term success of our businesses. We use best practices to empower teams with the knowledge and expertise to make the best decisions for their business. We operate with an entrepreneurial spirit, embracing critical thinking, innovation, and constant learning.

The Position

The HR & Benefits Administrator will join the Lumine Portfolio HR team to assist in and support the daily administration of USA and Canada benefits, 401k, leave of absence, and various compliance and governance programmes across multiple jurisdictions. This role reports into the HR Manager. The Portfolio HR team is responsible for providing shareholder value, M&A diligence and integration leadership, HR best practices, public company governance in pay equity, pay transparency, annual compensation and bonus processes, benefit program management in Canada and the USA, and decentralized governance oversight to our Business Units throughout the globe. We are looking for an adaptable candidate who is excited to work in a fast-paced, innovative, high-growth environment. The ideal candidate will be a self-starter, who enjoys learning on the go.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with Lumine Portfolio HR team to support the development and deployment of HR strategies that support business goals.

  • Support the daily administration and compliance of the USA and Canada benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, life, STD, LTD, retirement plans, and ancillary benefits. Ensure compliance with USA benefits regulations and federal and state legislations.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for benefit inquiries within USA and Canada. Escalating to the Portfolio HR Manager as necessary.

  • Support the Leave of Absence Management programmes across the US and Canada.

  • Support the compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations.

  • Support with annual compliance reporting and processes in the USA such as EEOC, ACA and 401k Audits.

  • Support and lead the I-9 management process.

  • Lead the FMLA Wage and Hourly Tracking Audit, in conjunction with the Portfolio HR Manager.

  • Assist with the quarterly HR Governance and Compensation Committee reports.

  • Own HR inbox management and triage.

  • Support the creations of playbooks including FMLA and Canada LOA playbooks.

  • Review and validate invoices generated by benefits administration systems

  • Special Projects: including but not limited to, leading implementations, review programs for continuous improvements, analyze data, etc.

Qualifications:

  • College or University degree in Human Resources, Business or a related field.

  • Minimum of 2-4 years of HR or Benefits Specialist experience. With at least 2 year’s experience supporting US Benefits and LOA processes.

  • Certifications: PHR, SPHR, SHRM-CP, or SHRM-SCP certification preferred.

  • Strong knowledge of USA employment laws and regulations.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Strong problem-solving and conflict resolution skills.

  • Proficiency in HRIS and other HR software. Workday experience an asset.

  • Resourceful and analytical; able to apply practical solutions to complex problems.

  • Previous experience with project management considered an asset.

  • Demonstrated ability to deal with people sensitively, tactfully, and in confidence.

  • Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment. Excels under pressure and able to meet tight deadlines.

  • Strong attention to detail.

  • Ability to work irregular hours within a global environment.

Lumine Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

raw.description:
Alkami is the digital sales and service platform provider for U.S. banks and credit unions. Our unified Platform integrates onboarding, digital banking, and data and marketing—each solution can stand alone, but together they deliver more—to help institutions onboard, engage, and grow relationships. As the future shifts toward Anticipatory Banking, we help data-informed bankers meet the moment with technology that drives action.

Founded in 2009, we continue to be recognized for our intentional culture and tremendous growth (Best Place to Work in Fintech; Best & Brightest to Work For Nationally; and Comparably’s Best Company Culture, Best Career Growth, Best Engineering Team, and Best Places to Work in Dallas, among others). We’re building a culture where each Alkamist can perform to their highest potential, and we’re always on the lookout for the best and brightest minds. If you’re ready to experience the power of alchemy - transforming the ordinary into the extraordinary - come join one of the fastest growing SaaS companies in the U.S.

As a remote-first company, most of our positions can be remote in the US, except for key roles, which will be indicated in the Job Title.

Follow us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn!

Alkami is seeking a Lead Product Manager based in the United States to own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of the data platform that will power much of Alkami's broader product strategy moving forward. This is a senior individual contributor role with influence and scope that extends across multiple engineering groups, multiple product surfaces, and a multi-year platform vision.

In this role, you will lead product across two engineering organizations: one focused on data ingestion (acquiring, landing, and onboarding data from a growing set of internal and third-party sources), and one focused on data cleansing, modeling, and insights generation (curating that data into trusted analytic models and the intelligence that sits on top of them). Together, these teams form the foundation of a unified data layer that other Alkami product teams build on, and an evolving intelligence layer that takes our machine learning capabilities to the next level.

The ideal candidate combines deep domain knowledge of modern data platforms with the technical fluency to engage credibly with engineering, the strategic judgment to operate at a platform level, and the leadership presence to align stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, and Client Success.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own and evolve a multi-year roadmap spanning data ingestion, data modeling, and the intelligence capabilities built on top of them.

  • Translate Alkami's broader product strategy into a coherent platform strategy, ensuring the data layer is a true force multiplier for downstream product teams and client outcomes.

  • Define and champion the product vision for the unified data layer and the intelligence layer that sits on top of it, including how native, client, and third-party data sets are surfaced through a single, consistent experience.

  • Drive a strong point of view on data governance, quality, lineage, definitions, and standards across both ingestion and modeling domains.

  • Define and monitor the key business and platform metrics that measure success, and use those insights to continuously optimize delivery and value.

Data Ingestion, Modeling & Intelligence

  • Partner with the data ingestion engineering team to deliver scalable, cloud-native pipelines that onboard new data sources reliably, securely, and cost-effectively.

  • Partner with the data cleansing, modeling, and insights engineering team to deliver curated, high-trust analytic models that power both internal analytics and external client experiences.

  • Shape the intelligence layer roadmap in close partnership with Data Science, advancing Alkami's machine learning capabilities from point solutions toward a coherent, reusable intelligence platform.

  • Act as the voice of the customer—synthesizing input from financial institution clients, internal analysts, and product teams—to prioritize work that maximizes platform value.

  • Own and manage the backlog(s) for the teams you support: well-organized, prioritized, and aligned with the roadmap, with clear user stories and acceptance criteria.

Cross-Functional Product Leadership

  • Lead product across two cross-functional Scrum teams (engineers, designers, QA, data scientists), driving alignment without owning the org chart.

  • Serve as the central product point of contact for Sales, Client Success, UX, Engineering, Data Science, and other Product teams that depend on the data platform.

  • Partner with peer Product Managers across Alkami to ensure the data platform meets the needs of the products built on top of it and the strategic bets the company is making.

  • Lead the Agile ceremonies relevant to your teams—sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives—and help shape how product and engineering operate together at the platform layer.

  • Collaborate with engineering leadership to define scope, sequencing, dependencies, and resourcing across both teams.

  • Mentor and uplevel other product managers and adjacent roles through example, coaching, and clear product craft.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.

  • 10+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent on data platforms, analytics products, or developer/internal platforms.

  • Demonstrated experience operating at a lead or principal level: setting direction across multiple teams, influencing senior stakeholders, and owning outcomes at a platform or portfolio scope.

  • Prior experience in fintech, digital banking, SaaS, or another regulated, data-intensive domain strongly preferred.

  • Must be based in and authorized to work in the United States. This is a U.S.-based, remote-first role.

Technical & Domain Expertise

  • Strong fluency in cloud-native data architectures: data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouse patterns, streaming and batch pipelines, and modern modeling approaches.

  • Hands-on familiarity with AWS data services and the broader modern data stack; able to engage credibly with engineers on architectural and trade-off conversations.

  • Experience productizing client-facing data and analytics capabilities, including exposing curated and client-owned data sets through unified, analyst-friendly experiences.

  • Solid working understanding of machine learning productization—how models move from experimentation to production, and what it takes to build a durable intelligence layer on top of a data platform.

  • Experience launching and scaling platform or data products, ideally including a 0–1 offering brought from concept to general availability.

  • Deep knowledge of Agile methodologies, including Scrum, and experience leading multiple Agile teams in parallel; comfortable with tools such as Jira and Confluence.

  • Strong grasp of security, privacy, compliance, and performance considerations relevant to financial data.

Analytical Mindset & Communication

  • Demonstrated ability to use data to drive decisions, inform prioritization, and measure success at a platform level.

  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences—including executives and clients.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured, first-principles approach to ambiguous problems.

  • Proven ability to influence without authority, build trust across organizations, and rally cross-functional teams around a shared platform vision.

Why This Role

This is a foundational role at Alkami. The data platform you help shape will underpin a significant portion of Alkami's product strategy for years to come — from how clients access and act on their data, to how our intelligence layer evolves on top of our unified data layer. If you want to lead product at the platform level — where the decisions you make influence many teams, many products, and many clients — this role is built for you.

The salary range for this position is: $164,000-$205,000

Cool Things to Know

Not Just Any Company: Alkami has an awesome diverse and inclusive environment. We have a FUN culture and offer great benefits, including remote-first environment, unlimited paid time off, 401(k) with employer match, and more.

Work Authorization: We cannot offer employment sponsorship at this time. Candidates must be eligible to work in the US for full-time employment.

Recruiters: We are not looking for outside recruiting firms to help us in this search. Thank you for understanding.

Pay Transparency: As of January 1, 2023, new states and locales have enacted pay equity laws that require more pay transparency by employers in the following states: California, Colorado (effective January 1, 2021), Connecticut, Maryland, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Rhode Island and Washington.

The Important Stuff

Alkami Technology is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Prohibits Discrimination and Harassment of Any Kind: Alkami is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Alkami are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Alkami will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Alkami encourages applicants of all ages.

WHO ARE YOU

Builders. Problem-solvers. Curious minds. People who move fast, embrace innovation, and believe we're stronger together.

If you trust your skills and want to build real technology that reshapes an entire industry, join us now.

ABOUT NESTO AND NESTO CLOUD

Canada's leading mortgage technology company.

Nesto is Canada’s leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, managing $73B+ CAD in residential and commercial mortgages, with 1,000+ team members across 12 offices nationwide. You will be working on Nesto Cloud, Canada’s most advanced cloud platform, delivering end-to-end technology solutions for lenders in the digital age.

ABOUT THE ROLE

At nesto, we are building Maestro: an AI platform that makes mortgage professionals dramatically more productive across sales, underwriting, and loan servicing. This is not "AI theater"— Maestro is already live, actively assisting underwriters with real files today.

As the Product Manager for the AI Platform, you will help turn this early proof-of-concept into the platform that defines AI-augmented lending in Canada. You will sit at the intersection of complex operational workflows, machine learning, and real mortgage expertise to turn hard problems into shipped product.

Why nesto’s approach to AI is different:

  • We sit where the work happens: We have direct access to the workflows, policies, and expert feedback inside real mortgage operations across the full lending journey.
  • Built for a regulated industry: Most AI companies build isolated demos or point solutions. We embed AI directly into production, continuously learning from human underwriter judgment.
  • End-to-end integration: We don't just solve one piece of the puzzle; we connect the full lending stack to make AI practically and systemically useful.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

  • Turn complex operational reality into clear PRDs, decision logic, and shipped product
  • Work closely with ML, engineering, underwriting ops, and business stakeholders to define and deliver the roadmap
  • Define and improve the metrics that matter: throughput, time-to-decision, accuracy, and capacity gained
  • Build tight feedback loops between AI output and expert human judgment
  • Keep execution moving in a high-ambiguity, high-accountability environment
  • Stay ahead of how AI is reshaping mortgage origination and bring informed recommendations to the roadmap
  • Share what you discover — how you work should make the people around you better

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The profile.

  • 3-5 years of experience in consulting or a high-ownership product role in a complex environment
  • Ability to write clearly, think structurally, and go deep on systems, data, and edge cases
  • Comfortable operating without perfect inputs — you find the truth, make the call, and drive the work forward
  • Proven, active fluency with AI tools across your PM workflow: discovery, testing, documentation, analysis, and measurement.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to non-experts in Product and Engineering

PREFERRED BUT NOT A MUST

  • Mortgage or regulated financial services experience — curiosity, rigor, and execution matter more
  • Familiarity with LOS systems, origination platforms, or lending technology
  • Exposure to AI or ML-assisted decisioning, document intelligence, or automation in a financial services context
  • Familiarity with broker and advisor-facing workflows and the nuances of supported versus self-serve client journeys

INTERVIEW PROCESS

How we get to know each other.

  • Recruiter Screen – 30 minutes
  • Discovery Call with Director of Product – 30 minutes
  • Take-home Assignment followed by Presentation and Q&A – 60 minutes
  • Final Stakeholder Interview – 45 minutes
  • Criminal Record and Reference Checks + Offer

THE REWARD

What you get.

  • The A-Team: Work alongside high-performing talent in product, tech, and the mortgage industry.
  • Accelerated Growth: The slope of your learning curve here will be vertical. You will touch more production systems in one year than you would in five years elsewhere.
  • Top-Tier Coverage: Premium benefits plan fully paid by nesto, including comprehensive insurance and unlimited access to telemedicine and mental health services for you and your family.
  • Rest & Recharge: 4 weeks of vacation to ensure you stay at peak performance.
  • Best-in-Class Tools: Everything you need to execute without friction, including the AI tools that make you faster.
  • Working Framework: The environment that makes you productive and enables real teamwork.

Diversity and Inclusion

At nesto, we believe that creativity and collaboration are the result of a diverse team. We are committed to fostering a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging, and we strongly encourage women, people of colour, LGBTQIA+ individuals, and individuals with disabilities to apply. We are committed to creating a workplace that is inclusive and welcoming to all.

Job Title: Full Stack Developer (AI-First)
Department: Engineering
Reports To: Engineering Lead
Location: Remote, CST
Compensation: Competitive salary based on experience

About Us:

We are a fast-growing, high-performance agency operating at the intersection of eCommerce, Amazon, growth, systems, and AI. Our team helps ambitious brands scale, and were increasingly focused on building internal tools, automation layers, intelligence systems, and AI-powered products that drastically improve business operations. We are not interested in using AI in a superficial way—were creating an AI-native agency model where intelligent systems enhance internal workflows, data visibility, decision-making, execution speed, and product capabilities.

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • Youre satisfied with maintaining old workflows or outdated methods.
  • You dont think about the future of AI and emerging tools.
  • You struggle to quickly learn new tools and technologies.
  • You prefer working in slow-moving, non-agile environments.
  • You dont enjoy building scalable, high-performance software.

This Role IS For You If:

  • Youre passionate about AI and building intelligent systems that drive real business impact.
  • Youre a builder who thrives on experimenting with new technologies and pushing boundaries.
  • Youre fluent in both frontend and backend development and excited by full-stack engineering.
  • You think in terms of leverage: automating processes, making workflows smarter, and using AI to increase output and decision-making.
  • You are a self-starter who takes ownership, moves fast, and is excited to work in a fast-paced, high-agency environment.

What Success Looks Like:

In your first 90 days, you will:

  • Build Scalable Systems: Develop modern full-stack applications, covering frontend, backend, databases, and infrastructure.
  • Integrate AI: Use Claude Code and other AI tools to drive faster development and smarter workflows.
  • Prototype New Ideas: Experiment with new products and features, quickly prototyping and refining the best ideas into production systems.
  • Automate Workflows: Develop AI-first workflows and automation tools to eliminate repetitive tasks.
  • Collaborate with Leadership: Work closely with leadership to identify high-leverage areas where AI and software can have the biggest impact.

Your Responsibilities:

1. Full Stack Development

  • Frontend Development: Build modern, scalable front-end applications using frameworks like React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
  • Backend Development: Develop backend systems with Node.js, Python, and scalable system designs.
  • System Design: Design and implement APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure to power applications.

2. AI Integration

  • Claude Code Utilization: Use Claude Code extensively to speed up software development, including building, debugging, refactoring, and exploring architecture.
  • AI-First Tools: Build AI-powered utilities and tools that integrate seamlessly into business processes.

3. Product and System Innovation

  • Automation: Automate internal processes, including data workflows, and build agent-based systems to reduce manual work.
  • AI Copilots: Create AI assistants and intelligent interfaces that help internal and external users improve productivity.
  • Prototyping: Rapidly prototype new product ideas and features, then refine the most promising ones into production-ready systems.

4. Collaboration & Experimentation

  • Leadership Collaboration: Partner with leadership to identify opportunities where AI and software can create leverage and deliver value.
  • Tool and Model Experimentation: Stay on the cutting edge by experimenting with new AI models, tools, and frameworks.

What Were Looking For:

Required Skills & Traits:

  • Strong experience as a Full Stack Developer.
  • Experience with modern frontend tools like React, Next.js, TypeScript, or similar.
  • Strong backend experience using Node.js, Python, APIs, databases, and scalable system design.
  • Proficiency with Claude Code for building, debugging, and optimizing software.
  • A genuine obsession with AI, emerging tools, and the future of software development.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively in a fast-moving team.
  • Ability to move quickly, take ownership, and solve complex problems with minimal direction.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open-source models.
  • Familiarity with building agent frameworks, RAG, vector databases, or tool-calling systems.
  • Experience building internal platforms, analytics systems, or automation tools.
  • Startup or high-performance agency experience.
  • Experience shipping software quickly while maintaining high engineering standards.

Why This Role Is Different:

This is not a maintenance role. Its not for someone comfortable with slow-moving corporate environments or traditional development. This role is for someone who wants to help shape the future of an ambitious, AI-first company and play a key part in developing the products that come out of it. Youll have room to experiment, push ideas forward, and help define how AI truly integrates into a business with real momentum.

Application Process:

  1. Submit Your Application: Send your resume and a brief cover letter detailing your relevant experience.
  2. Assessment: If shortlisted, complete an assessment to showcase your technical skills and ability to think strategically.
  3. Interview: Candidates will go through 1-2 rounds of interviews to evaluate your full-stack development expertise, AI fluency, and problem-solving approach.

Ready to Shape the Future? Apply Now!

We are an equal opportunity employer and celebrate diversity in our workforce.

Join DaVita Integrated Kidney Care (IKC) as an Engagement Specialist


At DaVita IKC, engagement is everything. As an Engagement Specialist, you’ll be the first point of contact for patients—onboarding, scheduling, and keeping them connected through high-volume, relationship-focused outreach. This role is perfect for someone organized, motivated, and skilled at building trust while helping patients navigate their healthcare journey.


Position Details:

  • Location:Remote, work from home. This is currently a Remote position. However, we value in-person patient care and may transition to a hybrid-remote model in the future.
  • Schedule: Monday–Friday, full-time schedule with the ability to accommodate patient availability- flexibility is key. No nights, No weekends, No on call. Daily may start time between 7:00–8:00 AM
  • Home environment must include a quiet, private office space with high-speed internet (Ether cable may be required) to support efficient use of all programs.

Engagement Specialist Responsibilities:

  • Facilitate CHE completion in nephrology offices, dialysis clinics, or via telehealth; coordinate with Nurse Practitioners and clinics to prepare for in-person appointments
  • Perform outbound calls to patients, caregivers, and clinics for CHE scheduling, reminders, and rescheduling; schedule telehealth CHEs for patients unable to attend in person
  • Welcome new patients to the program and collect any new concerns from existing patients; escalate to RN or Nurse Practitioner as appropriate
  • Maintain accurate documentation and communicate patient updates to the care team
  • Demonstrate exceptional interpersonal skills to build trust, influence patient participation, and overcome barriers to engagement
  • Organize outreach efforts by urgency and importance to maximize patient impact

Care Coordinator Responsibilities:

(May represent some role responsibilities)

  • Coordinate care for patients by ensuring access to eligible resources/programs and assisting with referrals and provider appointments
  • Perform outbound calls and respond to inbound calls from patients, providers, and Village resources
  • Complete non-clinical screenings and pathways under the guidance of the Manager; escalate to Integrated Care Nurse as needed
  • Assist the clinical team with moving patients through the continuum of care by completing tasks as directed
  • Identify eligible resources for members and collaborate with Integrated Care Nurses, dialysis clinics, health plans, and other stakeholders to help members enroll in programs
  • Communicate directly with patients in a timely and professional manner
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and confidential documentation
  • Demonstrate exceptional two-way communication, both oral and written
  • Act in alignment with DaVita’s mission and values to deliver high-quality patient care

Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or GED required; Associate’s or Bachelor’s Degree preferred
  • Previous IKC experienced required
  • 2+ years professional experience in customer service, patient-facing, or telephonic outreach roles preferred
  • Prior healthcare experience preferred
  • Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, active listening, and motivational engagement techniques
  • Highly organized, with excellent time management and follow-through
  • Ability to work both autonomously and collaboratively with care team members
  • Home workspace must provide a quiet, private environment with reliable high-speed internet

Why You’ll Love Working Here:

  • Directly impact patient care and engagement for complex chronic conditions
  • Be part of a mission-driven, collaborative care team
  • Flexible hybrid schedule with opportunities for professional growth
  • Supportive environment that values innovation, communication, and patient-centered care

Join our team and help patients navigate their care journey

More than just pay, our DaVita Rewards package connects teammates to what matters most. Teammates are eligible to begin receiving benefits on the first day of the month following or coinciding with one month of continuous employment. Below are some of our benefit offerings.

  • Comprehensive benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) match, paid time off, PTO cash out
  • Support for you and your family: Family resources, EAP counseling sessions, access Headspace®, backup child and elder care, maternity/paternity leave and more
  • Professional development programs: DaVita offers a variety of programs to help strong performers grow within their career and also offers on-demand virtual leadership and development courses through DaVita’s online training platform StarLearning.

At DaVita, we strive to be a community first and a company second. We want all teammates to experience DaVita as "a place where I belong." Our goal is to embed belonging into everything we do in our Village, so that it becomes part of who we are. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and comply with state and federal affirmative action requirements. RTX has an opening for a SAP EWM Functional Consultant - Implementation and Maintenance (configuration) (Manager, (hands-on) Business Systems and Transformation) role.

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

We are currently seeking Account Partner Directors to join our growing Professional Services sales team in Travel, Transportation and Hospitality. As a critical member of the Go-To-Market and Professional Services Team, you are responsible for building relationships with our license sales and extended functional teams (such as product, success managers, creative teams, legal, delivery and more) to understand, evaluate and strategically advise our internal teams and the customer on programs to execute on their vision and goals. You will be responsible as the deal originator, strategist and execution quarterback supported by our delivery organization.

Responsibilities

  • Drive thoughtful, strategic and enterprise level strategy for our most ambitious customers

  • Facilitate qualification, deal cycle participation, account reviews and value assessments

  • Drive awareness within a micro-vertical to develop repeatable motions

  • Enable smooth transition and partnership into our delivery team with effective margins, staffing plans, approach and Salesforce methodology

  • Serve as a key SME, leader, and professional services consultant to our license sales teams

  • Serve as the liaison between internal teams and the customer

  • From Operating Model:

  • The Account Partner (AP) is accountable for creating and executing a strategy that builds mind-share and broad adoption of Salesforce technologies on his/her assigned accounts.

  • The AP ensures alignment with Sales and is responsible for developing relationships within his/her account(s) to accelerate value and improve customer outcomes, and help uncover new opportunities for Salesforce.

  • The AP is accountable for bookings, revenue, margin, CSAT, and value delivered across his/her assigned account(s) and serves a key contact for customer negotiations and escalations

An Account Partner earns the right to be considered a trusted advisor to the customer by providing execution excellence, intimate knowledge of the business the customer is in, and able to clearly lay out the path the customer needs to take to achieve success. They independently identify and close opportunities with the primary goal of helping customers generate significant business value from their Salesforce investment. They are responsible for sourcing and closing Professional Service Business in a region, owning bookings, sales performances, forecasting, managing customer lifecycle, driving adoption through sales activities for new and existing customers, pipeline generation and delivering sales presentations to C-level clients.

  • Individually responsible for the success of a specific territory and patch. Consistently demonstrates the ability to develop, manage and elevate Accounts to Tier 1 /2

  • Accountable for a larger quota

  • Utilizes a consultative selling approach across all client levels, particularly C-Suite stakeholders

  • Demonstrate strong executive presence and confidence when sharing a strong point of view through effective storytelling

  • Ability to move fast and drive results

  • Influences leaders and orchestrates internal alignment to provide best solutions

  • Flawlessly navigate across all our internal teams to create synergy and alignment in driving the deal to closure maximizing both license and services bookings.

Qualifications

  • You have worked within a consulting landscape for a minimum of 8+ years

  • You have experience driving a strategic motion, including value propositions, execution planning, teaming and outcomes based engagements

  • You have served as a book-of-business owner or leader for 6+ years

  • You have worked within a consulting services space either with a systems integrator or product organization

  • You have experience delivering strategic initiatives and/or programs for a firm-based model or product company

  • You have the ability to create assets from scratch including marketing, sales and strategy solutions

  • You have the ability to maneuver and work with the C-Suite during a strategy cycle including workshopping

  • You have experience working with global procurement leads to negotiate pricing and deal strategy

  • You have experience working within one or more of the following industries - Business Services; Travel, Transportation & Hospitality.

Unleash Your Potential

Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.

Summary

The Data Scientist supports Empower’s Responsible AI (RAI) program by embedding directly with AI Factory teams and ensuring AI and GenAI applications are safe, measurable, transparent, and aligned with Empower’s Responsible AI principles. This role partners with assigned factory teams as a matrixed expert, executes Responsible AI evaluations, contributes to methodological development, and participates in research and prototyping of emerging RAI techniques.

Key Responsibilities

Embedded Responsible AI Support

  • Serve as the Responsible AI data science partner for assigned AI CoreWorks Factory teams, supporting integration of evaluation workflows, guardrails, and measurement practices.
  • Guide teams in applying Responsible AI platform capabilities, including real-time guardrails, hallucination scoring, explainability modules, and batch evaluation processes.
  • Support definition and maintenance of AI application configurations as part of onboarding, control mapping, and ongoing lifecycle management.

Responsible AI Evaluation and Method Implementation

  • Execute evaluations related to hallucination, fairness, contextual grounding, transparency, robustness, and other model behavior risks.
  • Develop benchmark datasets, evaluation scripts, and structured testing methods that enable consistent assessment across AI applications.
  • Analyze model architectures, data characteristics, and inference workflows to inform evaluation design and interpretation of results.
  • Partner with QA teams to align evaluation outputs with testing thresholds, validation workflows, and platform guardrails.

Machine Learning and Model Analysis

  • Apply machine learning, statistical, and experimental design techniques to assess model behavior and performance in applied contexts.
  • Evaluate how training approaches, data sources, model configurations, and deployment patterns influence Responsible AI outcomes.
  • Review and assess third-party or open-source models and tools from a safety, robustness, and evaluation perspective.

Research and Prototyping

  • Contribute to research, experimentation, and prototyping of emerging Responsible AI methods and evaluation techniques.
  • Explore new approaches in areas such as hallucination detection, explainability, fairness assessment, and model risk measurement.
  • Participate in proofs of concept and experimental analyses used to determine readiness of new metrics or methods for broader adoption.
  • Partner with engineering teams to help transition successful prototypes into platform-ready capabilities.

Collaboration, Documentation, and Governance Support

  • Collaborate with AI/ML engineers to operationalize evaluation logic and integrate Responsible AI metrics into shared platforms.
  • Assist with preparation of model cards, evaluation summaries, transparency documentation, and lineage records.
  • Provide analytical input to governance reviews, audits, and cross-functional consultations as needed.
  • Coordinate closely with global RAI data science partners to align methods, backlog priorities, and standards.

Telehealth Occupational Therapist

🚀 Work from Home | 🌏 Be Part of the Future of Therapy | 📍 Must Be Based in Australia

At XRHealth, we are at the forefront of healthcare innovation, delivering allied health services through telehealth and immersive Virtual Reality technology. We combine clinical expertise with engaging digital health tools to support children, adolescents and adults across Australia to build confidence, independence, emotional regulation, wellbeing and real-world functional skills.

As our services continue to grow, we are looking for a motivated and experienced AHPRA registered Occupational Therapist to join our multidisciplinary allied health team. This is a unique opportunity to deliver meaningful therapy from home while being part of an innovative organisation helping shape the future of digital healthcare.

About the Role
As a Telehealth Occupational Therapist with XRHealth, you will work with clients and families to deliver evidence-based therapy through a combination of telehealth and VR-supported intervention.

You will be supported by our operations team, allowing you to focus on what matters most: delivering high-quality therapy and helping clients achieve meaningful outcomes.
Previous VR experience is not required. We provide training, support and guidance to help you confidently integrate immersive technology into your clinical practice.
Part-time options are available.

What You’ll Do
Your responsibilities will include:

  • Conducting comprehensive initial assessments to determine client suitability for telehealth and VR-supported services
  • Delivering evidence-based Occupational Therapy interventions aligned with client goals
  • Supporting children and adolescents with functional skills, emotional regulation, confidence, social participation, independence and wellbeing
  • Working with neurodiverse clients and their families in a person-centred, strengths-based way
  • Monitoring and documenting client progress in line with professional and clinical standards
  • Preparing assessment reports, progress reports and summaries for families, referrers and other stakeholders
  • Collaborating with families, carers and other professionals to support meaningful outcomes
  • Maintaining professional registration and practice standards in line with AHPRA requirements
About You
We are looking for an enthusiastic Occupational Therapist who is passionate about delivering engaging, goal-based therapy in a flexible telehealth environment.

The ideal candidate will have:
  • A tertiary qualification in Occupational Therapy
  • Full registration with AHPRA as an Occupational Therapist
  • A minimum of three years’ clinical experience
  • Experience or strong interest in paediatric Occupational Therapy
  • Experience working with children, adolescents and neurodiverse clients
  • An understanding of the NDIS framework and goal-based therapy approaches
  • A Medicare Provider Number, Working With Children Check and NDIS Worker Screening Check, or willingness to obtain these
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills
  • Full working rights in Australia
  • A suitable work-from-home setup, including high-speed internet and access to a computer, laptop or tablet
  • An interest in emerging technology and the role of VR in Occupational Therapy practice

The Benefits
  • Work from anywhere in Australia and save on commuting time and costs
  • Be part of a pioneering organisation integrating VR into allied health practice
  • Access training, support and collaboration within a multidisciplinary team
  • Use engaging digital tools to support real-world functional outcomes
  • Join a forward-thinking team shaping the future of therapy delivery
  • Deliver meaningful therapy to clients who may otherwise face barriers accessing services


Why Join XRHealth?
At XRHealth, you will have the opportunity to work in a flexible, supportive and innovative environment where clinical care and technology come together. You will be part of a team that is passionate about improving access to therapy and helping clients build the skills, confidence and independence they need in everyday life.

Ready to Shape the Future of Occupational Therapy?
Please submit your CV and a cover letter outlining your experience and interest in the Occupational Therapist role.

Department:

WDTech - R&D

We are Walker & Dunlop. We are one of the largest providers of capital to the commercial real estate industry, enabling real estate owners and operators to bring their visions of communities — where people live, work, shop, and play — to life. We are committed to creating meaningful social, environmental, and economic change in our communities.

WDTech is W&D’s in-house technology team – a group of collaborative and highly skilled technology professionals, all of whom are leading experts in real estate data, data science, and technology.

WDTech Engineering builds solutions that impact not only our products but also the people and processes across our organization. A commitment to innovation and a passion for disrupting the old-fashioned real estate industry are our highest priorities.

The Impact You Will Have

As a Senior BI Analyst, you will partner with product teams and business stakeholders to deliver trusted analytics and reporting solutions in Power BI. This role is responsible for gathering requirements, translating business needs into scalable reporting solutions, and developing high-quality semantic models, dashboards, and reports that support data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Working closely with Data Engineers, Software Engineers, and the Enterprise Business Intelligence team, you will help ensure reporting solutions are accurate, scalable, well-governed, and aligned with business priorities.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead requirements gathering sessions with stakeholders across business and product teams.
  • Translate business needs into detailed reporting requirements, data definitions, and technical specifications.
  • Serve as a liaison between business users, Software Engineers, Data Engineers, and BI teams to ensure alignment throughout solution delivery.
  • Design, build, and maintain Power BI semantic models, reports, dashboards, and related reporting solutions.
  • Develop scalable data models, measures, hierarchies, and governance-ready reporting definitions.
  • Create intuitive dashboards and reporting experiences that support business decision-making and user adoption.
  • Support deployment, publishing, permissions management, refresh schedules, and release coordination for Power BI solutions.
  • Maintain documentation for reporting solutions, data definitions, and business logic.
  • Participate in Agile development activities including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and standups.
  • Gather user feedback and support ongoing enhancements and continuous improvement of reporting solutions.
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, preferably in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, reporting, or business analysis roles.
  • Experience gathering and documenting requirements for business intelligence or reporting initiatives.
  • Strong experience working with enterprise data platforms and OLAP databases such as Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, or similar technologies.
  • Experience developing Power BI semantic models, dashboards, and enterprise reporting solutions.
  • Experience with Microsoft SQL Server technologies including SSRS, SSAS, or semantic-model-based BI architectures preferred.
  • Commercial real estate or financial services industry experience preferred.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong proficiency with Power BI, including semantic models, report development, publishing workflows, and dashboard design.
  • Strong SQL and data modeling skills, including dimensional modeling concepts such as star schemas, fact tables, and dimension tables.
  • Understanding of ETL processes, data transformation techniques, and enterprise reporting best practices.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working in Agile environments and collaborating across cross-functional teams.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, and related collaboration tools preferred.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • High level of accountability, attention to detail, and commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Ability to show ownership of your work, take on challenges and acknowledge growth opportunities, and demonstrate patience when learning new processes
  • Courtesy, respect, and thoughtfulness in teaming with colleagues and other stakeholders

raw.description:
About the team

The Industry Data & Marketplace Strategy team sits at the center of Zillow’s work across Multiple Listing Service (MLS) strategy, broker feeds, and marketplace dynamics. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, MLS Operations, and Industry teams to ensure we have the data, insights, and strategy needed to support a healthy and scalable real estate marketplace.
Our work spans listing ingestion, data governance, and understanding how broker and MLS behaviors shape marketplace outcomes. We focus on translating complex, often ambiguous industry dynamics into clear, data-driven insights that inform strategic decisions across Zillow.

About the role

As a Senior Analyst on the Industry Data & Marketplace Strategy team, you will play a key role in scaling Zillow’s data-driven approach to industry strategy.

This role is designed for a strong, highly independent analyst who can take ownership of complex analytical problems and operate effectively in ambiguous spaces. You will work across MLS and broker-related initiatives, building datasets, uncovering insights, and helping shape how Zillow understands and navigates the broader real estate ecosystem.

You will partner with cross-functional stakeholders to define problems, structure analytical approaches, and deliver insights that influence both strategy and execution. Given the evolving nature of industry and marketplace work, priorities may shift as new questions and opportunities emerge—success in this role requires the ability to adapt quickly, re-scope work, and focus on the highest-impact problems.

You will get to

  • Build and own datasets spanning MLS feeds, broker feeds, and marketplace data

  • Analyze listing behavior and brokerage dynamics across markets to identify trends and opportunities

  • Support strategic initiatives related to listing ingestion, data governance, and marketplace health

  • Partner with Legal, Operations, Product, and Engineering to translate business and policy questions into analytical frameworks

  • Develop scalable reporting and dashboards to support ongoing decision-making

  • Identify gaps in data and proactively connect disparate data sources to generate insights

  • Frame ambiguous problems into clear analytical questions and deliver actionable recommendations

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $98,900.00 - $158,100.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, and Vermont the standard base pay range for this role is $94,000.00 - $150,200.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • 5+ years of experience in an analytical role, using data to inform business or strategic decisions

  • Highly proficient in SQL and comfortable working with modern analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Databricks, SQL-based reporting environments)

  • Working knowledge of Python; experience using AI-assisted tools (e.g., LLMs such as Claude or ChatGPT, or coding copilots) to accelerate analysis or development

  • Proven ability to work with complex, imperfect, or incomplete datasets

  • Strong track record of independently structuring and solving ambiguous problems

  • Ability to connect data insights to business context and influence decision-making

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain both findings and underlying reasoning to cross-functional stakeholders

  • Strong ownership mindset with a bias toward action

  • Ability to independently scope and structure analytical projects, including defining the problem, identifying required data, and aligning on approach with stakeholders

  • Foundational understanding of the real estate ecosystem (e.g., MLSs, brokerages, or listing data), or demonstrated ability to quickly build domain expertise in a new space

  • You are comfortable operating with limited direction, asking the right questions, and piecing together incomplete information to form a clear point of view.

  • You proactively leverage tools—including AI—to increase your speed, depth, and impact.

  • Previous experience working with MLSs, brokerages, or real estate data is preferred, but not required.

Transferable Skills:

At Zillow, we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non-traditional backgrounds and encourage people with transferable skills or related experience to apply.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help customers navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company that's reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the country. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.

Job Description

A bit more about this role:

Devoted Medical, Devoted Health's virtual-first, AI-native medical group delivering multi-specialty and advanced primary care, is seeking a dynamic, experienced, and mission-driven physician leader. As the Medical Director Episodic Care and Enterprise Safety, you will be a chief clinical architect of our next-generation care delivery model in the post-ED, post-hospital and post-acute care space. You will lead the charge in transforming how acute care is delivered outside traditional hospital walls, ensuring that every patient encounter across the national acute care continuum is safe, effective, and seamlessly connected to long-term health outcomes. Your work will define the "moat" of our business—a blend of human expertise and AI-driven precision that makes our care model irreplaceable.

Because Devoted is a tech-forward, fast-moving organization, our physician leaders are expected to support the development and application of AI tools that enable an unprecedented quality of care for our patients.

This role is designed for a senior physician leader with an entrepreneurial mindset who can leverage their experience to transform the care model, cultivate a standard of clinical excellence within a distributed team, and build and champion the implementation of evolving AI technologies. In this capacity, the national medical director will act as the ultimate point of accountability over clinical and financial outcomes of a large and scaling business unit.

Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

National Clinical Leadership

  • Lead and scale interdisciplinary care teams that support patients across the full acute care continuum at a national scale, fostering a culture of excellence and clinical rigor.

  • Responsible for hiring and managing the leaders of a growing team of physicians and advanced practice providers

  • Designing performance management systems that balance impact across multiple dimensions: clinical outcomes, patient experience, staff engagement, and productivity to have impact on a national scale

Episodic Care Model Ownership

  • Drive the strategy and business success for episodic care in the post-ED, post-hospital, and post-acute phases.

  • Instrument a reliable AI-enabled system that surfaces high value care pathways that are personalized to the patient context and ,

  • Expand the clinical aperture to avoid unnecessary reuse, and ensure durable outcomes that extend well beyond the critical 7-30 day window. This includes performance in 3 high value event based stars measures: Plan All-Cause Readmissions (PCR), Follow-up in patients with multiple co-morbidities after ED visits (FMC), and transitions of care (TRC) patient engagement.

Virtual 'Observation' Program

  • Build and scale a high-touch, virtual in-home "observation" level of care program. This program will serve as a safety net for patients at high risk of rehospitalization due to new or unresolved acute conditions.

Enterprise Quality & Safety

  • Serve as the Medical Leader for the Patient Safety Organization (PSO). Leverage deep intelligence from acute events to implement critical safety patterns and quality standards across the entire enterprise.

Who thrives in this role:

  • You are an excellent clinician who cares deeply about the well-being of your patients and brings strong judgment to both clinical and operational decisions.

  • You are a builder. You can stand up a new service line from scratch and manage all the parts: people, operations, vendors, technology, and cross-organizational coordination.

  • You are energized by AI and technology and see them as tools to make care better, not threats to the craft of medicine.

  • You are a happy warrior. In a great environment with smart, caring people working toward a common aim, you are comfortable working hard.

  • You are wired for learning, change, and rapid iteration. You would rather try something, learn, and adjust than wait for perfect information.

  • You think in terms of the big picture and sweat the details. You can present a vision to leadership and then turn around and solve a workflow problem on the front line.

Skills and Experience:

  • Board-certified physician (emergency medicine, internal medicine, or family medicine preferred) with 5+ years in clinical practice, willing to continue practicing in a virtual care setting.

  • Experience leading and managing clinicians, including advanced practice providers.

  • Experience building or scaling a clinical program or service line, not just operating within one.

  • Comfort working with engineering, product, and data teams. You don't need to write code, but you need to think clearly about how technology shapes care delivery.

  • Experience designing interventions to improve population health outcomes and an understanding of how to measure and track care quality.

  • Experience working in interdisciplinary teams across clinical and non-clinical functions.

  • Experience with virtual care, Medicare populations, or urgent care preferred.

If you want to build something that has never existed before, at the intersection of clinical medicine, technology, and operational excellence, and do it alongside a team that is as talented as it is kind, we'd love to hear from you.

Salary Range:$275,000 - $380,000 / year base salary

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.
